module.purpose: Provides a promise-aware URL fetch cache and a data-URL resource helper for editor exports.
module.summary: This module creates a bounded least-recently-used cache around asynchronous URL fetches. It stores in-flight promises so concurrent requests for the same URL share work, applies the same request initialization to every fetch, delegates response conversion to a caller-provided callback, and converts fetch, assertion, or callback failures into logged null results. The exported resource helper specializes the mechanism for blob-to-data-URL conversion.
module.businessContext: Supports editor export workflows that retrieve remote resources and convert them into embeddable data URLs. Failures become unavailable resources rather than propagating errors, so export may continue with missing content.
functions: fetchCache (~L3-21): Creates a bounded asynchronous URL cache with callback-based response conversion.
fetchCached (~L6-21): Reuses or produces a promise for one URL fetch operation.
systemCapabilities: Convert fetched blobs into data URLs

io: Logs caught fetch, assertion, and callback errors with console.error.
network: Fetches each cache-missing URL using the imported fetch implementation and supplied request initialization.

detail.name: fetchCache
detail.signature: export function fetchCache<T>(cb: (response: Response) => Promise<T>, init?: RequestInit)
preconditions: cb must be callable and return a Promise<T> when given a Response.
Each invocation of the returned function must receive a string URL.
postconditions: The returned function resolves to the callback result for a successful cached or uncached request.
The returned function resolves to null when fetching, response validation, or callback processing fails.
Requests for the same URL reuse the cached Promise while its result remains in the LRU cache.
invariants: The cache is private to the fetcher returned by each fetchCache invocation.
At most 100 URL entries are retained by the cache.
The supplied init object is reused for fetches performed by the returned function.
A URL's Promise is inserted into the cache before the asynchronous fetch operation settles.
edgeCases: A repeated URL returns the existing cached Promise without invoking fetch or cb again while the entry is retained.
Concurrent calls for the same URL share one Promise and one underlying fetch operation.
A fetch rejection, assertion failure from a non-ok response, or callback rejection is caught, logged with console.error, and resolves as null.
A successful callback result of null is cached and returned as null.
When more than 100 distinct URLs are cached, older entries may be evicted according to LRU behavior and a later request may fetch again.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Fetch, non-ok response assertion, and callback errors are caught; the returned Promise resolves to null.

stateMutations: Creates and mutates a private LruCache<string, Promise<T | null>> for URL-to-Promise entries.
detail.ioFormatSpec: The returned function accepts a string URL and performs fetch(url, init). It passes the Response to cb and resolves to Promise<T | null>; unsuccessful fetch or callback processing resolves to null.
detail.summary: Creates a URL-keyed asynchronous fetcher that caches in-flight and completed results with an LRU capacity of 100. Fetch or callback failures are logged and represented as null results.

specLiterals.role: Sets the private LRU cache capacity.
The URL string is the cache key and fetch target.

detail.name: fetchCached
detail.signature: async function fetchCached(url: string): Promise<T | null>
preconditions: The captured cache, fetch initialization value, and response callback are available.
postconditions: If a cached entry exists for url, that entry is returned unchanged.
If no cached entry exists, a promise is stored for url before the fetch completes and that promise is returned.
A successful response is passed to the captured callback and its result is returned.
Fetch, assertion, or callback failures result in null rather than propagating the error.
invariants: At most one new fetch promise is created for a URL while its cached entry remains present.
The cached value for a newly requested URL is the promise representing the complete fetch-and-transform operation.
Errors in the asynchronous operation are logged before null is returned.
edgeCases: When url already has a cached entry, fetch is not called and the cached entry is returned.
When fetch rejects, the returned promise resolves to null and the error is logged.
When the response has ok false, assertion failure is caught, logged, and the returned promise resolves to null.
When the callback rejects or throws, the error is caught, logged, and the returned promise resolves to null.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Any error from fetch, response assertion, or the response callback is caught; the error is logged with console.error and null is returned.

stateMutations: The captured cache is updated with the promise for url when no cached entry exists.
detail.summary: Fetches and transforms the response for a URL, caching the resulting promise so repeated or concurrent requests reuse it. Fetch, response assertion, and callback failures are contained and produce null.
